purpose: Decide whether a 6000 ms shared budget for three sequential pairs creates acceptable completion and missingness mechanics. This calibration does not validate any psychological interpretation, Gate D mapping, Gate E aggregation, latency meaning, or trait claim.

diagnostics_only.note: These diagnostics constrain interpretation of timing quality but do not independently assign psychological meaning or alter participant scoring. Device gaps are reported when at least device_gap_min_n_per_group clean blocks exist in each compared category.

decision_rule.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: fewer than min_clean_primary_blocks after inclusion rules
decision_rule.REJECT_6000: one or more red thresholds are crossed
decision_rule.ADJUST_AND_RETEST: data floor is met, no red threshold is crossed, but one or more green thresholds fail
decision_rule.KEEP_6000: data floor is met and every estimable green threshold passes
decision_rule.note: ADJUST_AND_RETEST or REJECT_6000 does not automatically choose 7000/7500/8000 ms. The next candidate budget must be versioned and retested under the same presentation protocol.
